requirements.text: The system shall accept buy, sell, and query instructions from the Transaction User Interface.
The system shall validate instructions against rising and falling price limits.
The system shall freeze user funds upon receipt of a valid buy instruction.
The system shall match buy and sell instructions based on price-first and time-first principles.
The system shall support the cancellation of pending trading instructions.
The system shall provide an interface for the Information Releasing Module to query stock prices.
The system shall automatically remove instructions that remain unfinished at the end of the trading day.
The system shall log all instructions and transaction results for audit purposes.
The system shall handle high-frequency instruction processing, including fetching, dealing, and canceling.
The system shall implement strategies to maintain stability and prevent crashes when processing overhead exceeds capacity.
The system shall provide restricted access to the Trading System Management module for authorization and maintenance.
The system shall provide a simplified terminal interface for end-users requiring only basic mouse and keyboard operations.
The system shall maintain data integrity in the database during instruction processing and matching.
The system architecture shall allow for future modifications to support new requirements by maintainers familiar with Java and socket programming.
